title: 第25章 赵小义扛刀上门
novel_title: 丰腴小村妇，大佬们跪求嫁给他(锦绣钱澄)
content_zh: 窗缝里开始漏进微光。哗哗哗哗！哗哗哗哗！蚊帐上的塑料膜快速地颤抖起来。呃~徐喜弟也不自觉地跟着大声吆喝不停。……借着微光，趴墙缝的张国海和范金花，眼睛都瞪直了。如果不是徐喜弟回来太晚，他们这辈子都见识不到这样的场面！塑料膜已经抖成了筛糠，有一小半被抖落下来，垂到帐前。蚊帐柱甚至已经传出来轻微的断裂声。一对大白雪子晃得他们眼花缭乱。范金花不自觉地按了按自己的胸口，心里暗想，也不差到哪里去。要是……多好……她咽了咽口水。……张永福睡得并不沉，尤其听到了吆喝声后，更是瞪大了眼。贱人！贱人！喊得他心里直发毛。他不会让她生孩子的，怀了就捶死在她肚子里！咬着牙，一个转头，看到躺旁边的巴儿姐，在竖着耳朵……甚至还把自己的衣领扒开，半敞着，一只手伸进领口。贱人！都是贱人！张永福怒气滔天，伸手就往巴儿姐前面用力一掐。嗷~巴儿姐大叫了一声，长腿往张永福身上用力一蹬，直接把人踢进了墙缝。“啊！！！爸！妈！你们快来！”张永福的尖叫声，惊了家里所有的人。徐喜弟惊得神经都绷紧了，她刚想回头，就被一件衣服盖住脸。很快，身后的人激流勇退。等她虚着力把头上的衣服扒开，屋里已经空了。管不了了，她软软躺在床上，拉起被子盖住身体。张永福挑事可真会挑时候啊。……范金花和张国海也被尖叫声吓得猛一抖。这孩子，这个点就醒？两人匆匆下床，去张永福的屋里看。就见巴儿姐没事人一样，翘着二郎腿躺在那里。床里的位置空了，也没找见张永福。“永福呢，去哪儿了？”范金花拍拍巴儿姐，她只阿巴阿巴说着什么。“我在床底下~”张永福在床底下哭喊。因为外墙是泥胚墙，为了防泥渣子掉床上，所以里边床沿会留出一点空缝。巴儿姐把人踹进缝里去了！范金花低头在床下寻找，果然看到张永福挂着一脸蜘蛛网，满嘴灰……两口子大惊失色，连忙把人从床底下拉出来。“疼疼疼……”张永福一碰就喊疼。“给老子闭嘴！掉个床，能有多疼！再叫我给你嘴巴缝上。”张国海好戏正看得上瘾，被打断了，心里不痛快，骂了一句。在他眼里，儿子二十三年来，就没有一天不矫情。“这个哑巴，把我踹床底下，我肚子受伤了！”张永福也怒火正盛，直接就顶。“你怎么她了，她才踹你的吧？”张国海把地上的人抱起来，往床里一扔。同时范金花把若无其事的巴儿姐拉起来，“去去，你去跟喜弟睡！”张永福一听，老母亲让姐姐去跟徐喜弟睡，又不干了。“凭什么她去！要去也是我去！我要去打死那个贱人！”“闭嘴！”张国海怒喝，巴掌已经抬了起来。“行了行了，往后他自己会想明白的。”范金花把他拽了出去。……徐喜弟又一次睡到日上三竿。眼睛还没睁开，耳朵就已经被声声呻吟打扰。“哎哟，哎……疼死我了。”“哎，哎哟……疼死了。”张永福一个人在屋里喊，也没人管他。这是闹了多久？公婆也不管的？徐喜弟起床出房门，家里三个人，各忙各的，仿佛只有他一个人听见张永福的叫唤。“你们都盼我死。”“那我就死。”“死了我变成鬼魂，也要回来掐死孽种。”“哎哟，好疼，快送我去医院……”范金花就在堂屋里剁猪菜，一脸冷漠。到了火房，巴儿姐在烧火烤糍粑，张国海在后院，也不知道在忙什么，总之各忙各的。“妈，阿福昨夜怎么了？”还是徐喜弟于心不忍，问了一句。“昨夜里睡觉，掉床了。今晚巴儿姐跟你睡，那边床小太挤……”范金花耳朵里始终回荡儿子说的那句话，怀了也捶死在肚子里。徐喜弟一听，愣在那里。让巴儿姐跟她睡，意思从今天开始，傻叔不会再来了。不再来了……徐喜弟松了一口气，终于不用再夜夜折腾。五碗饭的威力，真让她快受不住了。“徐喜弟，你给老子出来！”院外，赵丁的儿子赵小义扛着一把长柄柴刀，扯着嗓子叫嚣。咔！他在院门上砍了一刀。“张国海，你个软蛋，给我出来！”本来在后院的张国海，透过篱笆墙看过去，被眼前的情形吓得连忙进屋，把门牢牢顶上。范金花先是愣了愣，也没敢露脸，伸长脖子往门外探了探，看到院门的门柱已经被砍了一个大口子，也吓得脸色发白。“看看，招惹这种狗杂种，往后还有好日子过吗？”徐喜弟也给吓了一大跳。都知道赵家父子混蛋，但是这么光天白日就扛刀上门，整条村还是头回。这就报仇来了。徐喜弟看看自己的细胳膊细腿，心想这下要怎么收场？她也只能先把大门和后门给严严实实关上，顶牢。现在是白天，赵小义这么大呼小叫的，相信很快就会有村民报给大队长。咔！咔！咔！赵小义咬着牙砍了好几下，院门哗啦一声，倒下了。“出来！张家一个个怂货，出来呀！再不出来，我把你们家院子铲平咯！”他一边叫，手上也没停。院门倒下了，他就砍篱笆墙。可是张家依旧不敢开门，徐喜弟躲在门后，除了等大队长带人来绑人，她一时也没招。可村民就跟看热闹似的，没人上前劝，更没人去报队长。就眼睁睁看着赵小义砍平篱笆墙，又开始耙菜地。菜地相比之下，就砍得快多了，三五下，就平了一大片。他还不解气，举着柴刀就来到正门口。嘭！上来就把门板砍穿了一条缝。柴刀也嵌在门板里，他摇了好几下才拔出来，然后高高扬起，准备砍第二下。徐喜弟后退了几大步，吓得拍着小胸胸，心脏怦怦怦直跳。范金花干脆就捂着耳朵。张永福在屋里，也不嚎了。只有巴儿姐，哈赤哈赤在火房门口，吃热糍粑。“赵小义，你这一刀砍下去试试？”院门口有人说话了。
content_en: A faint light began to leak in through the cracks in the window.Wow wow wow!Wow wow wow!The plastic film on the mosquito net trembled rapidly.Uh~ Xu Xidi unconsciously followed and shouted loudly....In the dim light, Zhang Guohai and Fan Jinhua, who were lying on the crack of the wall, stared wide-eyed.If Xu Xidi hadn't come back too late, they would never have seen such a scene in their lives!The plastic film had been shaken into chaff, and a small part of it was shaken off and hung in front of the tent.There was even a slight cracking sound from the mosquito net posts.A pair of big white snowflakes dazzled them.Fan Jinhua pressed her chest unconsciously, thinking to herself that it wasn't that bad.If only... It would be great... She swallowed....Zhang Yongfu did not sleep deeply, especially when he heard the shouting, his eyes widened.Bitch!Bitch!He shouted so hard that his heart went numb.He would not let her give birth to a child, and he would beat her to death in her belly once she was pregnant!Gritting his teeth, he turned his head and saw Sister Ba'er lying next to her, her ears pricked up... She even took off her collar, leaving it half open, and put one hand into the collar.Bitch!They're all bitches!Zhang Yongfu was so angry that he reached out and pinched Sister Ba'er hard in front of her.Ouch~ Sister Ba'er yelled and kicked Zhang Yongfu hard with her long legs, kicking him directly into the crack of the wall."Ah!!! Dad! Mom! Come on!" Zhang Yongfu's scream shocked everyone in the family.Xu Xidi was so shocked that her nerves were tense. Just as she was about to turn around, her face was covered by a piece of clothing.Soon, the people behind him retreated.By the time she tried her best to remove the clothes from her head, the room was already empty.Unable to control it, she lay softly on the bed and pulled up the quilt to cover her body.Zhang Yongfu really knows how to choose the right time to pick things up....Fan Jinhua and Zhang Guohai were also frightened by the screams.This child will wake up at this hour?The two of them hurriedly got out of bed and went to Zhang Yongfu's room to take a look.I saw Sister Ba'er lying there with her legs crossed as if she was fine.The seat on the bed was empty, and Zhang Yongfu was nowhere to be found."Where's Yongfu, where have you gone?" Fan Jinhua patted Sister Ba'er and said nothing to her."I'm under the bed~" Zhang Yongfu cried under the bed.Because the outer wall is a mud wall, in order to prevent mud and debris from falling onto the bed, there will be a little gap left on the edge of the bed inside.Sister Baer kicked someone into the crack!Fan Jinhua lowered his head to search under the bed, and sure enough he saw Zhang Yongfu with a face covered with spider webs and a mouth full of gray... The couple was shocked and quickly pulled him out from under the bed."It hurts, it hurts..." Zhang Yongfu cried out in pain as soon as he touched it."Shut up! How painful would it be to fall off the bed! Ask me to sew your mouth shut again." Zhang Guohai was addicted to watching the show and was interrupted. He felt unhappy and cursed.In his eyes, his son has not been pretentious even a day in the past twenty-three years."This mute kicked me under the bed and my stomach was hurt!" Zhang Yongfu was also furious and directly hit him."What's wrong with you? She kicked you, right?" Zhang Guohai picked up the person on the ground and threw him into the bed.At the same time, Fan Jinhua pulled Sister Ba'er up who was calm and said, "Go, go, sleep with Brother happy!" When Zhang Yongfu heard this, the old mother asked her sister to sleep with Brother Xu Xi, but she stopped."Why should she go! I'm going to go too! I'm going to beat that bitch to death!" "Shut up!" Zhang Guohai shouted angrily, his palm already raised."Okay, okay, he will figure it out by himself in the future." Fan Jinhua dragged him out....Xu Xidi slept until three o'clock in the morning again.Before I even opened my eyes, my ears were already disturbed by moans."Ouch, ouch...it hurts so much." "Ouch, ouch...it hurts so much." Zhang Yongfu shouted alone in the room, and no one paid attention to him.How long has this been going on?Your parents-in-law don’t care?Xu Xidi got up and went out of the room. The three people in the house were busy with their own things. It seemed that he was the only one who heard Zhang Yongfu's call."You all hope that I die." "Then I will die." "If I die, I will become a ghost, and I will come back and strangle the evildoer." "Ouch, it hurts, take me to the hospital quickly..." Fan Jinhua was chopping vegetables in the main room with an indifferent expression.When we arrived at the fire room, Sister Ba'er was lighting a fire and roasting glutinous rice cakes, while Zhang Guohai was in the backyard. He didn't know what he was busy with, but they were all busy with their own things."Mom, what happened to Ah Fu last night?" Xu Xidi couldn't bear it and asked."I fell out of bed while I was sleeping last night. Sister Ba'er will sleep with you tonight, and the bed over there is too crowded..." Fan Jinhua's ears always echoed with her son's words, and she beat herself to death even when she was pregnant.When Xu Xidi heard this, he was stunned.Let Sister Ba'er sleep with her, meaning that starting from today, the stupid uncle will not come again.Not anymore... Xu Xidi breathed a sigh of relief, finally no longer having to worry about it every night.The power of five bowls of rice really made her unbearable."Brother Xu Xi, come out here!" Outside the hospital, Zhao Ding's son Zhao Xiaoyi shouted at the top of his voice, holding a long-handled hatchet.Click!He slashed at the courtyard gate."Zhang Guohai, you coward, come out!" Zhang Guohai, who was originally in the backyard, looked through the fence and was so frightened by what he saw that he quickly entered the house and locked the door firmly.Fan Jinhua was stunned at first, and did not dare to show his face. He stretched his neck and poked out the door. When he saw that a large hole had been cut on the doorpost of the courtyard door, his face turned pale with fright."Look, if you provoke such a bastard, will you still have a good life in the future?" Xu Xidi was also shocked.Everyone knew that the Zhao family and his son were bastards, but to come to the door with a knife in broad daylight made the whole village uncomfortable.Here comes revenge.Xu Xidi looked at his thin arms and legs and thought, how will this end?She could only close the front door and the back door tightly first.It's daytime now, and Zhao Xiaoyi is making such a fuss, I believe some villagers will report it to the team leader soon.Click!Click!Click!Zhao Xiaoyi gritted his teeth and slashed several times. The courtyard door crashed and fell down."Come out! Come out, all cowards of the Zhang family! If you don't come out, I will level your yard!" He shouted without stopping.When the courtyard gate fell down, he cut down the fence.But the Zhang family still didn't dare to open the door. Xu Xidi was hiding behind the door. She didn't do anything except waiting for the captain to bring someone to kidnap him.But the villagers were just watching the fun, no one came forward to persuade them, and no one reported to the captain.He watched Zhao Xiaoyi chop down the fence and start raking the vegetable field again.In comparison, the vegetable patch can be cut much faster. With just three or five strokes, a large area is leveled.Still not relieved, he came to the front door with a hatchet in hand.Bang!When he came up, he cut a crack through the door panel.The hatchet was also embedded in the door panel. He shook it several times before pulling it out, and then raised it high, ready to chop it a second time.Xu Xidi took a few big steps back, slapping his chest in fear, his heart pounding.Fan Jinhua simply covered her ears.Zhang Yongfu stopped howling when he was in the room.Only Sister Ba'er and Hachi Hachi were eating hot glutinous rice cakes at the door of the fire room."Zhao Xiaoyi, do you want to try cutting it down with this knife?" Someone spoke at the door of the courtyard.
